unsupportedClaims.claim: Led month‑end disbursement reconciliation close for the credit book at a commercial bank for twenty‑two months, serving as the named control owner in the finance control register, running the close timetable and signing the close‑out checklist. Held a delegated approval limit of 25,000 for reconciliation adjustments, approving adjustments within the limit in the reconciliation tool under my own user id and escalating larger ones to the finance controller with a proposed treatment. Maintained the reconciliation procedure and assembled the control evidence pack each month for internal audit, including the adjustment log, the sign‑off record and the break ageing report. Agreed the close timetable each month with treasury and the credit operations team, recording in the close plan that treasury owned the funding entries and credit operations owned the disbursement queue. Responsibilities included control ownership, adjustment approvals within limit, procedure maintenance and evidence packs for the disbursement reconciliation over about two years.
